title: Maker Bonanza
tagline: A day for Connecticut's makers, prototypers, artists and builders to trade ideas, find collaborators and meet the community they didn't know was there.
description: Maker Bonanza is an unconference: the people who come set the agenda. There are no keynotes to sit through. You propose what you want to talk about, teach or figure out, and the room sorts itself around it.

It's for anyone who makes things: makerspace members and the people who run makerspaces, independent makers, artists and crafters, hardware and climate-tech founders, software builders, students and faculty. You don't need to belong to a makerspace to come, and if you've been wondering whether one is for you, this is a good way to find out.
location: ClimateHaven and MakeHaven, 770 Chapel Street, New Haven

tiers.name: Scholarship
tiers.description: Use this if the $50 price would keep you from coming: you're a student, between jobs, on a tight budget, or paying your own way and it's a stretch. No application and no proof needed. If an employer or organisation is paying for you, please choose general admission so this stays available for someone who needs it.
tiers.attestation: The full price would be a barrier for me.

sponsor_pitch: Sponsorship is what makes the day affordable for the people it's for: tickets come close to covering food, and not much else. Sponsors put their name in front of the people building things in Connecticut, and help connect a community that has never been in one room.

terms:
DRAFT, not yet reviewed.

Tickets. Tickets are sold by MakeHaven, a partner makerspace, which handles the event's money. You can refund your own paid ticket from the link in your email until the end of January 4, 2027, when the catering count is set. After that there are no refunds, but you can transfer your ticket to someone else from the same link.

Your information. Your name, email and registration answers are seen by the organisers, MakeHaven and Redwood Endeavors, and are used to run this event and to send you logistics about it. We share them with Redwood Endeavors for this event, and Redwood Endeavors may follow up with you about it. Anything beyond that is your choice, using the opt-ins on this form, which you can change at any time from the link in your email. Sponsors do not receive attendee contact details.

Photos. Photos from the event will be posted to social media and may be used to promote MakeHaven, Makerspace Network and future events. You may ask not to be photographed during the event, and you may ask in writing for material featuring your likeness to be removed.

Participation. You must be 18 or older. Sessions are discussion, light crafting and teaching; no heavy machinery is used. Any assistance is given on a best-effort basis with no guarantee on any work. MakeHaven can take no responsibility for damage to property or person. You are responsible for your own safety and actions, and you agree to follow all safety instructions and signage.

Conduct. Treat people with respect. Harassment, discrimination and threatening behaviour are not welcome, and organisers may ask anyone to leave, without a refund. Raise any concern with an organiser on the day, or by replying to your confirmation email.
